ATC Vet — QJ01MA19. (garenoxacin) Profile Garenoxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibacterial with properties similar to those of ciprofloxacin (p.247). Garenoxacin is used as the mesilate but doses are given in terms of the base: about 507 mg of the mesilate is equivalent to 400 mg of garenoxacin. It is given orally in the treatment of susceptible infections in usu- al doses equivalent to 400 mg of garenoxacin daily.
